user.title: Set up Roller Shutter Suite
user.description: Do you want to set up Roller Shutter Suite? On the next pages you choose the settings for the whole house. Groups and windows inherit them until you override them there.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose what Roller Shutter Suite takes care of in the whole house. The next pages only ask about what you turn on here.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. When it is off, the daily routine moves nothing.

feature_daily_routine_general.title: Daily routine
feature_daily_routine_general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can start the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page for each kind of day.

data_description.schedule_morning_position: How far the shutter opens in the morning: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the morning a shutter is only raised; if it is already higher, it stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_evening_position: How far the shutter closes in the evening: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the evening a shutter is only lowered; if it is already lower, it stays where it is.
data_description.schedule_workday_source_choice: An entity that is on on workdays, for example a workday sensor of Home Assistant. With "None", Monday to Friday are workdays.
data_description.schedule_holiday_source_choice: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None", there are no public holidays.
data_description.schedule_season_source_choice: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it is unavailable or unknown, its last known state is used.
data_description.schedule_summer_by_date: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day set below.
data_description.schedule_summer_first_day: Month and day, two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May.
data_description.schedule_summer_last_day: Month and day, two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. Summer may run across the turn of the year.
data_description.schedule_evening_position_summer: Used instead of the evening position in summer, for example 30 % for privacy with some fresh air. It only applies if summer is set by an entity or by date.
data_description.schedule_brightness_source_choice: An entity that reports the outdoor brightness in lux. If it stays darker than the threshold for the set duration, the evening begins early, but never before the evening's "not before". While the entity is unavailable or unknown, it neither starts nor delays the evening.
data_description.schedule_brightness_threshold_lux: Below this outdoor brightness, in lux, it counts as dark.

expert.name: Advanced settings
expert.description: The defaults suit most homes. Change them only if you have a reason to.

data_description.schedule_brightness_delay: For how many minutes it has to be dark before the evening begins.
data_description.schedule_random_offset: Moves each morning and evening by up to this many minutes, earlier or later, differently for each window and each day. 0 turns it off; 30 is the maximum.

feature_daily_routine_workday.title: Daily routine on workdays

data_description.schedule_workday_morning_kind: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" in the advanced settings set the earliest and the latest time.
data_description.schedule_workday_evening_kind: A fixed time; sunrise in the morning or sunset in the evening, with an offset; or the elevation of the sun. For the two that follow the sun, "not before" and "not after" in the advanced settings set the earliest and the latest time.

feature_movement_general.title: Movement
feature_movement_general.description: How the shutters spare their motors: small comfort movements are left out, the shutters wait a while between two comfort movements, and when many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. Comfort movements are those of the daily routine, for example.

data_description.motor_min_change: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 turns this off. A shutter is still moved fully open or fully closed, however small the remaining distance. This works only for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved.
data_description.motor_min_interval: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, so that a shutter does not keep moving back and forth. 0 turns this off. Something new, such as the start of the morning or the evening, still moves the shutter at once.
data_description.stagger_gap: When many shutters move at the same time, their motors start one after the other. After each motor of this window, the next motor, of this window or another one, waits this many seconds. 0 turns this off for this window: its covers start together when its turn comes. Between the covers of one window the gap only matters if the window has several.

expert.name: Advanced settings
expert.description: The defaults suit most homes. Change them only if you have a reason to.

data.reevaluate_after: Check again at the latest after

data_description.reevaluate_after: When a movement has to wait for something whose end cannot be known, for example for a cover to become available again, the window is checked again after this time at the latest.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose what Roller Shutter Suite takes care of here. With "Inherit", the choice of the house or the group applies; the list shows what that is at the moment. The next pages only ask about what is turned on.

data_description.schedule_enabled: Opens the shutters in the morning and closes them in the evening. When it is off, the daily routine moves nothing. "Inherit" uses the setting of {schedule_enabled_source}.

feature_daily_routine_general.title: Daily routine
feature_daily_routine_general.description: How far the shutters open and close, how workdays, weekends and public holidays are told apart, and what else can start the evening. The times follow on the next pages, one page for each kind of day.

data_description.schedule_morning_position: How far the shutter opens in the morning: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the morning a shutter is only raised; if it is already higher, it stays where it is. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {schedule_morning_position_inherited} from {schedule_morning_position_source}.
data_description.schedule_evening_position: How far the shutter closes in the evening: 100 % is fully open, 0 % fully closed. In the evening a shutter is only lowered; if it is already lower, it stays where it is. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {schedule_evening_position_inherited} from {schedule_evening_position_source}.

data_description.schedule_holiday_source_choice: An entity that is on on public holidays; a calendar with an all-day event works too. With "None", there are no public holidays. Currently inherited: {schedule_holiday_source_inherited} from {schedule_holiday_source_source}.
data_description.schedule_season_source_choice: An entity that is on while it is summer. While it is unavailable or unknown, its last known state is used. Currently inherited: {schedule_season_source_inherited} from {schedule_season_source_source}.
data_description.schedule_summer_by_date: Without a summer entity, summer lasts from the first to the last day set below. "Inherit" uses the setting of {schedule_summer_by_date_source}.
data_description.schedule_summer_first_day: Month and day, two digits each, for example 05-01 for 1 May. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {schedule_summer_first_day_inherited} from {schedule_summer_first_day_source}.
data_description.schedule_summer_last_day: Month and day, two digits each, for example 09-30 for 30 September. Summer may run across the turn of the year. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {schedule_summer_last_day_inherited} from {schedule_summer_last_day_source}.

feature_movement_general.title: Movement
feature_movement_general.description: How the shutters spare their motors: small comfort movements are left out, the shutters wait a while between two comfort movements, and when many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. Comfort movements are those of the daily routine, for example.

data_description.motor_min_change: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 turns this off. A shutter is still moved fully open or fully closed, however small the remaining distance. This works only for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {motor_min_change_inherited} from {motor_min_change_source}.
data_description.motor_min_interval: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, so that a shutter does not keep moving back and forth. 0 turns this off. Something new, such as the start of the morning or the evening, still moves the shutter at once. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {motor_min_interval_inherited} from {motor_min_interval_source}.
data_description.stagger_gap: When many shutters move at the same time, their motors start one after the other. After each motor of this window, the next motor, of this window or another one, waits this many seconds. 0 turns this off for this window: its covers start together when its turn comes. Between the covers of one window the gap only matters if the window has several. Leave empty to inherit. Currently inherited: {stagger_gap_inherited} from {stagger_gap_source}.

window_covers_unreadable.title: Window "{window}" is not set up
window_covers_unreadable.description: The saved covers of the window "{window}" cannot be read, so Roller Shutter Suite does not take care of this window at all. All other windows work as usual. To repair this, open the window, choose its covers again and save it, or delete the window.

dry_run_unreadable.description: The saved settings do not show whether the window "{window}" is in dry-run. It is treated as being in dry-run, so it does not move. To repair this, open the window and save it.

option_unavailable.title: Window "{window}" cannot use the setting "{key}"

setting_combination.title: Saved settings contradict each other
setting_combination.description: Each of these saved settings is fine on its own, but together they are not allowed: {settings}. The name in brackets says where each one is saved. Please report it to the author of the integration.

setting_fault_global_unreadable.title: A setting of the house cannot be used
setting_fault_global_unreadable.description: The saved setting "{key}" cannot be read. Until this is repaired, settings that protect the shutters or limit their movements keep working: they use the same setting of the group or the house instead, and where neither has one, a cautious choice that may hold movements back more than usual. Comfort movements that depend on this setting, such as those of the daily routine, are suspended for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open Roller Shutter Suite, choose "Reconfigure" and save the settings of the house.

Comfort movements that depend on this setting, such as those of the daily routine, are suspended for the windows concerned, so that no shutter moves unexpectedly. To repair this, open the group, check its settings and save it, or delete the group.
